summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 10h 55m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  5 UAE stuck orders investigated. 4 progressed to COMPLETED per latest comment. 1 order (AE260812-57849665) remains at SHIPPING_REQUESTED after color swap and partial cancellation. Parallel investigation launched across Kibana, codebase, DB, and Jira. (35m)

AEME-6540 — 
  2 UAE trade-in orders stuck in clawback process — Checkout.com declined card re-authorization. No reusable PC ticket exists for clawback remediation. Remediation script pending user confirmation to re-trigger clawback payment. (2h 0m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation in progress — no RCA content yet. Lock file exists but no .md file with investigation findings. Awaits full ticket fetch and parallel fan-out investigation to produce RCA. (45m)

PC-53768 — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  No RCA file found — investigation not yet started. Ticket exists in Jira but no .md file was generated in the ticket-rca directory. Awaits investigation workflow activation to produce RCA. (1h 0m)

RT-702249 — 
  Investigation in progress — no RCA content yet. Only lock file exists, no .md file with investigation findings. Awaits full ticket fetch and parallel fan-out investigation to produce RCA. (35m)

SAHME-3357 — 
  14 ZA SC+ error orders investigated. 11 remediated after SMC team completed device and product mappings. 3 remain blocked on SMC-side issues (device model, identity document, product ID). Awaits SMC team confirmation to reset via PC-52678. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  Investigation in progress — no RCA content yet. Only lock file exists, no .md file with investigation findings. Awaits full ticket fetch and parallel fan-out investigation to produce RCA. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — 
  Investigation in progress — no RCA content yet. Only lock file exists, no .md file with investigation findings. Awaits full ticket fetch and parallel fan-out investigation to produce RCA. (45m)

SAME-3958 — 
  SA sales report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. Root cause is feature gap — infrastructure exists but Groovy script never included them. Remediation under PC-53689 adds two @ColumnMethod handlers. Awaits deployment. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — 
  18 SA-region refund failure orders under investigation. Parallel fan-out launched across Kibana, codebase, DB, and Jira. Sub requesting auto refund re-push or confirmation for manual refund. Investigation in progress.

Open tickets:

PC-53768 [To do] — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
